later_events.mechanism: redundant_relisting: EO 10480 (August 14, 1953), held APP transcription, section 607(5) lists EO 10223 among orders "superseded or revoked" two years after EO 10281 had revoked it. It is not the first end and adds no new end date.

clauses.reason: Terminated by express revocation. EO 10281 (Harry S. Truman, signed August 28, 1951), held APP transcription, section 404 (Part IV, Miscellaneous Amendments of Prior Orders) states: "Executive Order No. 10223 of March 10, 1951, is hereby revoked." The sentence states no later effective date, and section 503 of EO 10281 delays only Part II and section 501, so the signing date August 28, 1951 is the end date. The whole row ends on that date.

research_rationale:
EO 10223 (March 10, 1951, Harry S. Truman; 16 FR 2247), read in full in the held Federal Register text, designates the Atomic Energy Commission as an additional guaranteeing agency under section 301 of the Defense Production Act of 1950 and makes sections 301, 302 and 902 of EO 10161 and EO 10182 applicable to it to the same extent as to other guaranteeing agencies; its closing sentence says nothing in the order supersedes any provision of EO 10193. It is one operative paragraph. EO 10281 (August 28, 1951), held APP transcription, revokes it by number in section 404, which is in Part IV (miscellaneous amendments); section 503 delays only Part II and section 501, so section 404 took effect on signing. The same section 404 amends section 301 of EO 10161 to insert the Atomic Energy Commission among the guaranteeing agencies. EO 10480 (August 14, 1953) lists EO 10223 again in section 607 after it was already revoked; that listing is not the first end.

savings.reason: The designation of the Atomic Energy Commission as a guaranteeing agency was carried into section 301 of EO 10161 by the same section 404 of EO 10281, which inserts the words "the Atomic Energy Commission," after "the Department of the Air Force,"; the command therefore continued in another instrument while this order's text was revoked. Guarantees issued by the Commission before August 28, 1951 are acts under the order and are not shown to have been affected.
